'''Kurgan Dala''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==Biography==
As a child, Dala had always dreamed of becoming a starfighter pilot, but his large size made some worry that he would be too large to become one. Nonetheless, Dala was called to duty in the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]. Dala was quite happy with his job, but one day on a routine flight with the ''[[Comet's Wake]]'', he ran into a [[space wraith]]. Dala was unprepared for the the encounter, and the space wraith took a hold of him. After he became wraithbound, Dala began murdering co-workers and generally acting strangely.<ref name="UA" />
